headline: Marvin Harrison Jr.: A lot of factors why it didn't work in Arizona, just looking forward now
summary: There was a lot of talk about Marvin Harrison Jr. being a can't miss prospect when he came out of Ohio State and the Cardinals were thrilled to take him fourth overall in 2024, but Harrison's time in Arizona did not play out as hoped.

headline: Broncos S Talanoa Hufanga Facing Multi-Week Absence
summary: Ankle injuries are becoming an issue for the Broncos. After placing Pat Bryant on IR, Denver played without Patrick Surtain in Week 5 and will almost definitely do so again in Week 6. Those two injuries preceded Talanoa Hufanga going down against the Chargers. Hufanga has not practiced this week, and ESPN.com’s Jeremy Fowler notes […]

headline: Lamar Jackson remains out of practice Wednesday
summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter called the quarterback day-to-day with an ankle injury.

headline: Falcons QB Michael Penix on track to start vs. Bears if no setbacks, coach says
summary: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. will start Sunday against the Bears despite a rib injury, as long as there are no setbacks during the week.

headline: Baker Mayfield "getting better," will test thumb with Wednesday throwing session
summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield has missed the last two games since suffering a dislocated thumb.

headline: NFL reiterates plan to play Steelers-Saints in Paris, despite local unrest
summary: Ongoing social unrest in Paris has raised questions regarding the Steelers-Saints game due to be played there in 11 days.
